reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Pad Vita Touch 70P
reviews.text: Nice packaging. The pads are big and full of serum. I use them for targeted treatment of dark spots and leave them in place for 10 to 15 minutes. They can be split in half for more coverage. I am seeing an improvement in my stubborn dark spots by using this and a few other treatments, it just takes time.
reviews.zh: 包裝靚。化妝棉夠大又入滿精華。我會針對性咁用喺色斑嘅位置，貼住 10 至 15 分鐘。可以撕開兩半用嚟覆蓋更大範圍。色斑本身好頑固，配合埋呢件同其他護膚一齊用，見到有改善，不過要時間。

reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Pad Vita Touch 70P
reviews.text:
I have been using this skincare product for a few weeks, and I am very satisfied with the results. The texture is light and smooth, and it absorbs quickly into my skin without feeling oily or sticky.

It provides excellent hydration and keeps my skin soft and fresh throughout the day. After regular use, I noticed that my skin looks healthier and more radiant. I also appreciate that it is gentle and does not cause any irritation, which makes it suitable for my sensitive skin.
reviews.zh:
呢件護膚品我用咗幾個星期，對效果非常滿意。質地輕柔滑溜，皮膚吸收得快，唔會覺得油膩或者黏笠。

保濕效果出色，全日皮膚都保持柔軟清爽。持續用咗一陣，發覺皮膚睇落健康咗、有光澤咗。佢溫和唔刺激，啱晒我嘅敏感肌，我好欣賞呢一點。

reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Pad Vita Touch 70P
reviews.text: The glutathiosome sheet masks from Abib are my absolute favourite so I bought the toner pads to try as well, hope they work just as well!
reviews.zh: Abib 嘅谷胱甘肽面膜一直係我最愛，所以連化妝棉都買埋嚟試，希望一樣咁好用！

reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Pad Vita Touch 70P
reviews.text: This body wash is a game-changer! The combination of Glutathione and Niacinamide gently cleanses while brightening and smoothing my skin. It leaves my body feeling incredibly soft, hydrated, and refreshed without any tightness. The light, pleasant scent is perfect for daily use. After just a few weeks, I noticed my skin tone looks more even and radiant. No irritation even on sensitive skin. The pump bottle is hygienic and lasts long. Highly recommend for anyone wanting brighter, healthier-looking skin from shoulders to toes. Five stars!
reviews.zh: 呢款沐浴露真係 game changer！Glutathione 同 Niacinamide 嘅組合可以溫和清潔，同時提亮並撫平肌膚。沖完涼之後皮膚感覺超柔軟、保濕又清爽，完全唔會繃緊。淡淡嘅香味好怡人，適合每日使用。用咗幾個星期之後，我發現膚色睇落更均勻更有光澤。敏感肌都冇出現任何刺激。泵裝設計衛生又襟用。強烈推薦畀任何想由肩膀到腳尖都擁有更明亮、更健康膚色嘅人。五星好評！

reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Pad Vita Touch 70P
reviews.text: My all time favourite skin care product it makes my skin brighter right after use it’s really good feels so light on the skin doesn’t irritate my skin
reviews.zh: 我人生最愛嘅護膚品，用完即刻令皮膚更明亮，真係好好用，搽上面感覺好輕盈，又唔會刺激皮膚。

reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Pad Vita Touch 70P
reviews.text: My second tub. I like that the pad is smooth and soft. Great for a quick mask in the morning
reviews.zh: 已經係第二罐。塊面膜好滑好軟，適合一早做個快速 mask。

reviews.shade: Abib Glutathiosome Dark Spot Pad Vita Touch 70P
reviews.text: Very moist. Only use them after breakouts. Wish each of this tub would pack with more spot pads. Overall feel good of using them
reviews.zh: 非常濕潤。只係喺爆瘡之後先會用。希望每一罐都可以裝多啲痘痘貼。用落整體感覺唔錯。
